quarterly_data.signal: Business transfer: NEC agreed with a consortium led by Assist Group S.r.l. (an Italy-based conglomerate) to transfer its entire overseas network equipment resale business (building systems for overseas telecommunications operators and enterprises with partner companies' network equipment, in regions such as Latin America, the Asia-Pacific and Europe) and its IT services business for governments and local authorities in certain countries (system development for biometric authentication and smart cities, including parts of the business in Latin America and Europe); completion is expected during fiscal year 2026 subject to customary closing conditions, and NEC will continue to supply biometric authentication-related products in those countries after the transfer. NEC: the transfer is part of a business-portfolio review; overseas it will focus on its software and services business.
